verification_passes.defect_a_reconfirmation: Diffed against base to confirm the old sorted() comparator chain was dimension -> extractor id -> extractor version -> artifact -> observation_sort_key(first observation_id only). Confirmed ObligationResult::unknown/unsupported (adapter/src/semantic/batch.rs) both produce empty observation_ids AND evidence_refs, so they truly tied under the old key. Confirmed the new identity_key() folds in obligation.status.as_str() plus fully sorted observation_ids/evidence_refs/diagnostics (not just the first element). Confirmed case_a_unknown_vs_unsupported_is_order_independent constructs exactly this counterexample and asserts forward.sorted() == reversed.sorted() after ingesting both orders -- direct proof the fix closes the gap. Cases B-E also present and correctly targeted.
verification_passes.defect_b_reconfirmation: Confirmed observed_type_batch constructs SemanticObservation::Type(SemanticRecordHeader<TypeIdentity>) directly, with a genuine TypeIdentity subject -- no Symbol-header dimension mutation. Confirmed both observed_symbol_batch and observed_type_batch assert .is_dimension_consistent() immediately after construction. Grepped/read the full file: no mutation of a SemanticObservation's header.dimension without a matching variant change exists anywhere.
verification_passes.is_dimension_consistent_reconfirmation: Confirmed core/src/semantic/observation.rs's is_dimension_consistent() is a real check (self.header_dimension() == self.dimension()), not a stub, and that its 3 tests (Symbol-consistent, Type-consistent, malformed-mismatch-detected) all pass.
verification_passes.diff_range_sanity: git diff --stat over the full range touches exactly core/src/semantic/observation.rs and runtime/src/census/extraction.rs; no CI/workflow files. Grepped for #[ignore], --no-verify, .skip(, 'beats', 'precedence', 'winner', and any new EpistemicStatus::Conflict assignment: zero matches beyond pre-existing assertions that no such status is ever synthesized. No new epistemic-status-like duplicate enum introduced; no reconciliation logic added.

determinism_fix.old_sort_key: SemanticDimension -> ExtractorIdentity.id -> ExtractorIdentity.version -> ArtifactId -> observation_ids.first() (empty string when observation_ids is empty)
determinism_fix.new_identity_key: SemanticDimension -> ExtractorIdentity.id -> ExtractorIdentity.version -> ArtifactId -> EpistemicStatus -> sorted(observation_ids) -> sorted(evidence_refs) -> sorted(diagnostics), all folded into one string via ExtractorObligationRecord::identity_key(); sorted() sorts by this key alone
determinism_fix.counterexample_closed: Two records for the same artifact/extractor/dimension, one UNKNOWN and one UNSUPPORTED, both with empty observation_ids and evidence_refs: tied under the old key (stable sort preserved insertion order, so forward vs reversed ingestion published differently); the new key includes status, so they never tie regardless of ingestion order.
determinism_fix.proof: 5-case test matrix (CASE A: UNKNOWN vs UNSUPPORTED tie; CASE B: same status, differing diagnostic ids; CASE C: observation/evidence list order invariance; CASE D: distinct extractor ids; CASE E: same extractor id, differing version), all asserting forward.sorted() == reversed.sorted() or direct identity_key() equality/inequality.

semantic_consistency_fix.old_malformed_fixture: A test constructed a 'TYPE observation' by taking a SemanticObservation::Symbol(header) and mutating header.dimension to SemanticDimension::Type without changing the enum variant -- variant tag said Symbol, header.dimension field said Type, obligation.dimension said Type: three disagreeing signals in one object.
semantic_consistency_fix.new_invariant: SemanticObservation::is_dimension_consistent() (core/src/semantic/observation.rs), checking header_dimension() == dimension() (the latter authoritatively derived from the variant tag, never from the header field). observed_type_batch now constructs a genuine SemanticObservation::Type(SemanticRecordHeader<TypeIdentity>); both observation-producing test fixtures assert this invariant at construction time, and a dedicated test re-checks it from the outside.

contract_clauses_satisfied: .atlas/contracts/SEMANTIC-EXTRACTION.md#determinism (publication order no longer depends on Vec insertion order, HashMap iteration, thread scheduling or wall-clock time for records that previously tied)
.atlas/contracts/SEMANTIC-FACTS.md (SemanticObservation's variant/dimension consistency is now an explicit, tested invariant rather than an implicit, silently-violable assumption)
.atlas/decisions/0002-epistemic-status-model.md (EpistemicStatus remains the sole canonical taxonomy; no CoverageStatus/AggregatedStatus/etc. introduced)
